'''Slider''' was a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] who worked for [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]].

==Biography==
In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], Slider was hired by [[Domina Tagge/Legends|Domina Tagge]] to bring her the [[orakny bloom]], a type of [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that could counteract the symptoms of the [[Crimson Forever]]. Slider found the orakny bloom but feared that [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] might be after him. Hiding out on [[Stenos/Legends|Stenos]], he tried to hire the [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] to leave the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and bring the orakny bloom to Tagge. Slider was eventually caught up by [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] hunters and [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="SW108" />
